_doc: Keys are GitHub numeric repository ids: the file holds no repository names; titles are chosen for public display. showcase: printed by public title; optional period overrides the repo's own dates. exclude: duplicates and repos with no own commits, dropped from every count (forks drop automatically). external: collaborations a fine-grained token cannot see: {id, language, since, until: YYYY-MM}; ignored when the token sees them.
